organization.zh: EEE DEV TEAM, Hong Kong Polytechnic University
organization.en: EEE DEV TEAM, Hong Kong Polytechnic University

heroCardDescription.zh: 从 login 到 submission、result 与 VIVA 的完整 student flow
heroCardDescription.en: A complete student flow from login to submission, result, and VIVA

problem.zh: Problem: 把学生从 login 到 result/VIVA 的路径做成连续产品流程
problem.en: Problem: turn login-to-result/VIVA into one continuous student product flow

heroSummary.zh: 我负责的是 student-side assignment journey：从 OTP login、consent、dashboard，到 assignment submission、history、result 和 VIVA follow-up，把这些页面做成一条连续而可维护的学习流程。
heroSummary.en: My work focused on the student-side assignment journey: from OTP login, consent, and dashboard to submission, history, result, and VIVA follow-up, turning separate pages into one connected and maintainable learning flow.

cardHighlights.zh: 围绕 student journey 交付登录、consent、dashboard、submission、history、result、VIVA 等关键页面与跳转逻辑
cardHighlights.en: Delivered the key student journey pages and transitions across login, consent, dashboard, submission, history, result, and VIVA

cardHighlights.zh: 坚持用 documented API contract 驱动前端接入，而不是把 endpoint 细节散落写死在每个页面里
cardHighlights.en: Kept the frontend integration driven by documented API contracts instead of scattering endpoint logic across individual pages

cardHighlights.zh: 让学生在提交后仍然保有上下文，可以继续查看 history、result 与 AI-supported VIVA follow-up
cardHighlights.en: Made the post-submission flow continuous so students could move from upload into history, result review, and AI-supported VIVA follow-up

value.zh: 学生在提交作业、查看历史记录、理解反馈和继续后续讨论时，往往要在割裂页面和不清晰状态之间来回切换。
value.en: Students often have to move through fragmented pages and unclear state transitions when submitting work, tracking attempts, reviewing feedback, and continuing post-submission discussion.

value.zh: 把 student workflow 做成一条完整、可追踪、对 API contract 友好的产品流程，而不是一组互不相连的页面。
value.en: Turn the student workflow into a complete, traceable, API-contract-friendly product flow instead of a set of disconnected pages.

value.zh: 最终形成了从 login 到 submission、result、VIVA 的完整学生路径，并通过 shared composables 和 local proxy pattern 提升了集成一致性。
value.en: The result was a complete student path from login to submission, result, and VIVA, with stronger integration consistency through shared composables and local proxy patterns.

items.zh: 把 assignment journey 整理成 parameterized routes，例如 `/assignment/{assignmentId}/submission`、`/history`、`/result`、`/viva`，让页面结构和实体边界更清晰。
items.en: Reshaped the assignment journey into parameterized routes such as `/assignment/{assignmentId}/submission`, `/history`, `/result`, and `/viva`, making the page structure and entity boundaries clearer.

items.zh: 实现并稳定真实的多步文件提交流程：file hash、upload ticket、presigned upload、upload completion、submission creation，而不是只做一个表单上传 UI。
items.en: Implemented and stabilized the real multi-step file submission flow: file hash, upload ticket, presigned upload, upload completion, and submission creation instead of a fake one-step upload UI.

items.zh: 把 API integration logic 从页面里抽离到 shared composables，减少 duplicated fetch logic，保持前端行为更贴近文档化 API contract。
items.en: Pulled API integration logic out of pages into shared composables, reducing duplicated fetch logic and keeping the frontend closer to the documented API contract.

items.zh: 这个项目的价值不在单个页面，而在于把学生从发现任务到提交、查看结果、继续讨论的完整学习路径做通。
items.en: The value of this project is not a single page, but the completed learning path from task discovery to submission, result review, and follow-up discussion.

items.zh: 它也证明了我不只是做视觉实现，而是会处理 route design、workflow continuity、API discipline 和状态迁移这些真正影响产品质量的部分。
items.en: It also shows that my work is not limited to visual implementation; it includes route design, workflow continuity, API discipline, and state transitions that materially affect product quality.

caption.zh: 这是我在面试里最推荐直接讲的一张图：清楚展示 student journey 是如何被串成一条连续路径的。
caption.en: This is the chart I would use first in an interview because it shows how the student journey becomes one continuous path.

caption.zh: 页面层保持 student-facing，shared composables 和 local Nuxt API proxy 承担了主要集成职责。
caption.en: The page layer stays student-facing while shared composables and local Nuxt API proxy routes handle the integration work.
